stage.purpose: Complete local candidate-stage adjudication and source/evidence delivery without new physical observations.

stage.unsupported_or_failed_cell: Stop affected dependent actions, retain raw state and do not infer unsupported from silence. A supported-rate failure is not a skip. remaining_required_not_executed.requirement: One selected same-parameter group: 30/30 complete zero-start successful 1 MiB transfers; >=9 KiB/s, P95<=120 s, every transfer<=150 s, clean unique-DATA retransmission<=1%, maxRetries=5.

One 4-hour continuous-transfer soak with a single host-monotonic observer started before the first cell; preserve action/idle/recovery/failure records, do not use summed App times or long idle as proof; stop new starts at 4 h and complete in-flight apply/readback.

Ten actual physical disconnect/recovery pairs, two each at durable 8/64/256/512/768 KiB, one selected parameter/asset group; exact fault route/checkpoint evidence required, no ABORT/force-stop/ordinary-success substitute.

All selected campaign observations require valid clock/metrics/guard, no integrity/unrecoverable failure, actual full target/unchanged group16 Boot/confirmation and complete original App snapshots; retain target safely at final closeout.

operating_rules.rollback: No device query, restore, rollback, reset, installation, cleanup or OTA is admitted.
operating_rules.evidence: Preserve every failed/uncertain action and original bytes. Raw App/RTT/Commander/phase/closure files are evidence, not generated summary replacements. Terminal old-App stack/clock must be before reset; missed windows are EVIDENCE_GAP, never re-run a successful OTA. The one explicitly authorized supplemental qualification measures the changed committed observer; it does not fabricate or repair v10 terminal evidence.
operating_rules.stop: New integrity/recovery/clock/guard failure pauses affected tests; no blind retry or new directory to erase uncertainty. trial5 is cause-unknown and its separate investigation remains deferred.
operating_rules.notifications: No manual mention for this contract/report. Only a necessary, already-authorized physical UI/card action while execution remains open and requires no chat reply uses current-session real mention plus receipt. Requests requiring a reply end normally.
operating_rules.foreground: Keep the original upgrade UI foreground. No P3-8/background expansion, automatic taps, native sender or custom collector replacement.
operating_rules.matrix_lifecycle: Only round15 is writable; all predecessors and their original outcomes remain unchanged.
operating_rules.history_commands: Evaluate original observations offline when the changed Validation profile prevents formal reuse; no physical replay.
operating_rules.usb_admission: Require actual phone presence and an unoccupied private port. Use the installed exact APK verification in Phone.start; do not reinstall the previously verified APK. No automatic UI taps. Request only necessary authorized physical actions.
operating_rules.phone_admission: Before the live cold launch, use existing private ADB read-only power/keyguard checks for current awake/unlocked state. Request only necessary already-authorized physical action; no UI taps or system setting changes.
